create_tools_task: create a Tools task instance that loads six tabletop props into the Aloha simulation scene
sample_props_positions: sample randomized 3D positions for six props across nine tabletop regions using a random state
initialize_episode_placement: initialize an episode by placing caddy, screwdriver, magnifier, can opener, thumb drive, and scissors on the table
configure_prop_placer: configure a PropPlacer with deterministic position sequences and uniform Z-axis quaternion rotations for props
load_gso_assets: load GSO MuJoCo XML assets for a caddy, screwdriver, magnifier, can opener, USB drive, and scissors into the scene
